title: Conjunto base de A Magistrada
style: Anime 2D sobrenatural, contornos de tinta, cel-shading, carvão, oxblood e ferro; ângulos e cenários variados no tribunal do Inferno.

assets.promptSummary: Retrato da Magistrada de cabelos prateados, máscara e gola de ferro no tribunal infernal.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square 1:1 character portrait for Post Mortem Arena, a dark supernatural 3v3 anime game
Primary request: original portrait of A Magistrada, a tyrannical infernal judge whose authority exposes, restricts and condemns. Design a memorable adult woman, visibly distinct from a generic human and from a crowned ruler: severe silver hair cut to the jaw with one narrow braid, one amber eye visible, the lower half of her face behind a small black iron docket-mask, a tall asymmetric collar of layered iron plates, oxblood judicial robe over angular charcoal armor, one heavy broken shackle chained around her forearm. No crown, no scales, no gavel.
Scene/backdrop: close portrait in a basalt tribunal gallery of the Inferno, distant iron archways and red-lit windows.
Style/medium: unmistakably hand-drawn 2D Japanese shonen anime character art, bold clean ink outlines, expressive anime features, flat cel shading with sharp graphic shadow shapes; no realistic painting, no 3D, no photographic skin.
Composition/framing: square 1:1 head and shoulders, slightly low three-quarter angle, face and iron-mask silhouette clear, centered and readable at small game-portrait size.
Lighting/mood: cold iron highlights against oxblood red and deep charcoal, severe and oppressive.
Constraints: one character only; coherent anatomy; no text, no UI, no logos, no watermark; no gore.
